newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae sets $700 million of REMICs.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae sets $700 million of REMICs.

text.p: Fannie Mae said it issued $700 million of Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) securities.

REMIC trust 1997-21 totals $300 million and was issued via Nomura Securities International Inc, Fannie Mae said. It is backed by 30-year, 8.0-percent mortgage certificates, priced February 28 and has a settlement date of March 31.

REMIC trust 1997-24 totals $400 million and was issued via Bear Stearns & Co, Fannie Mae said. It is backed by 30-year, 7.0-percent mortgage certificates, priced March 3 and has a settlement date of March 31.
